note: Machine-checkable research contract. The prompt_block below is rendered into the Meta AI prompt as the authoritative output contract for this brief, and this same file drives validate-research-contract.py. The two cannot drift: one source of truth.
prompt_block:
BRIEF CONTRACT: review-complaint signals. This section is authoritative for this brief and overrides any conflicting output instructions.
Reply with a numbered list. For EACH business you considered, including ones you reject, output ALL of these labeled fields:
  1. Business Name - Town - Trade
  Business: <name>
  Town: <town>
  Trade: <trade>
  Problem category: <exactly one of: phone problems | missed calls | no response | no callback | slow response | waiting | scheduling trouble | poor communication>
  Review timing: <when the 1, 2, or 3 star review was posted: exact date, or N days/weeks/months ago>
  Review rating: <1, 2, or 3: the actual low star rating, not the business average>
  Verification: <how you verified the business exists right now: Google Business Profile, own website, or Facebook page>
  Classification: <exactly one of: VALID | INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE | OUT_OF_GEOGRAPHY | DUPLICATE | STALE_REVIEW | WRONG_TRADE | WRONG_SIGNAL | BUSINESS_NOT_VERIFIED | CONTRADICTED>
Rules:
- The cited review must be dated within the last 90 days. If you cannot date it, classify INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never VALID.
- A review older than 90 days is STALE_REVIEW, never VALID.
- A business-average rating is not a review. Cite an actual 1, 2, or 3 star review.
- List every candidate you considered. Never silently drop one.
- Never name or quote reviewers. Paraphrase the problem category only; no quoted text in the problem or timing fields.
- End with 2-3 sentences on what you could NOT verify. The output is UNVERIFIED external research.
